niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, geography, creative needs, and whether you need platform-first, programmatic scale, or advanced measurement. Below is a practical way to think about options and some reputable vendors and agency types to consider.

Quick clarifying questions (so I can recommend specific agencies):
- What’s your primary goal? (brand awareness, direct response, app installs, attribution-driven sales)
- Monthly or campaign budget?
- Target geographies/markets?
- Do you need creative production for CTV (30–60s or interactive formats)?
- Do you want programmatic access (DSP) or publisher/platform direct buys (Roku, Hulu, Samsung)?
- Do you need advanced measurement/attribution?

Top vendors & agency types by use case
- Programmatic scale & advanced targeting: The Trade Desk (leading DSP), Magnite/SpotX (supply-side relationships) — good for broad programmatic reach and audience targeting.
- Platform-first / publisher buys: Roku OneView, Samsung Ads, Hulu/Disney/Paramount — best if you want to leverage a particular streaming platform’s first‑party data and guaranteed inventory.
- Creative & interactive CTV: Innovid — strong for dynamic, measurable creative and interactive CTV ads.
- Full-service global agency capabilities: GroupM (Mindshare/Wavemaker), Omnicom (OMD/PHD), Publicis (Starcom), Dentsu (Carat), IPG (Initiative/UM) — good if you want strategy, creative, and global media buying in one partner.
- Addressable/Advanced TV specialists: Cadent, Tremor Video, Amobee — often focused on linear-to-CTV, addressable audiences, and advanced TV planning.
- Measurement, verification & analytics: TVSquared, DoubleVerify, IAS (Integral Ad Science), Nielsen — important for viewability, verification, and cross-screen attribution.

How to choose the “best” for you (checklist)
- Campaign objective alignment (brand vs performance)
- Inventory access (platform direct vs open programmatic)
- Targeting & data (first‑party, deterministic, or probabilistic)
- Measurement & attribution (incrementality, conversion tracking)
- Creative capability (30s spots vs interactive/dynamic creative)
- Transparency & fees (bid-level transparency, auditing)
- Brand safety and fraud controls
- Reporting cadence and dashboards
- Geography and language coverage
- Past results / case studies in your vertical

Typical recommendations by budget
- Enterprise/global budgets: consider a top holding agency with CTV practice (GroupM, Omnicom, Publicis) or The Trade Desk for programmatic scale + specialist measurement partners.
- Mid-market: independent specialists (Cadent, Amobee, Tremor) or platform direct (Roku OneView) combined with a creative shop.
- Small/local budgets: platform buys (Roku, local streaming partners) or programmatic local DSPs that support CTV.

If you want, I can:
- Recommend 3–5 agencies tailored to your goals and budget
- Draft a short RFP you can send to agencies
- Compare two agencies you’re considering

Tell me your goals, budget, regions, and whether you need creative production, and I’ll shortlist the best matches.
